profile.name: Md. Mehedi Hassan
profile.title: IT & Aviation Security Specialist
profile.headline: SECURING MODERN TECH INFRASTRUCTURE
profile.about: Results-driven Technical Security & Aviation Specialist with proven operational leadership across international luxury hotels, mega commercial hubs, convention centers, and high-density NOC data centers. HCSA certified by Hikvision and trained by CAAB in Airport Security Management. Adept at orchestrating multi-layered physical and digital security architectures, designing SOPs, mitigating physical and cyber risk vectors, and leading high-performance technical defense teams.

points: Directed full-scope workplace safety protocols, access control integrity, and administrative workflows.
Supervised deployed security personnel, duty rosters, post assignments, and strategic threat responses.
Managed central CCTV control monitoring, BioStar biometric access systems, and visitor databases.
Formulated corporate security SOPs, emergency evacuation procedures, and technical vendor SLAs.
Spearheaded security operations across 5-star international hotels, convention centres, and shopping malls.
Supervised maintenance contracts, troubleshooting, and performance audits for enterprise surveillance walls.
Conducted comprehensive threat investigations, physical audits, and risk minimization measures.
Liaised with senior management and law enforcement authorities during high-profile corporate security events.
Delivered responsive Tier-1/2 customer support with rapid first-contact resolution benchmarks.
Assisted in security consultancy projects, evaluating client security requirements and tailored connection plans.
Maintained direct technical communication with enterprise partners including BRAC Bank.
Administered enterprise network backbones, sustaining 99.9% uptime across routing infrastructures.
Led a 7-engineer NOC team, reducing incident response latency by 50% across corporate client tickets.
Maintained core data center servers, firewall rules, bandwidth distribution, and disaster recovery plans.
Provided Tier-3 escalation support, diagnosing complex routing anomalies with an 88% FCR rate.
